summary: Cadre Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its Canadian subsidiaries entered into an amended and restated revolving line of credit with PNC Bank Canada Branch. The facility allows borrowings up to CDN$20.0 million, matures December 20, 2029, and is guaranteed by Safariland, LLC. Borrowings bear interest at base rate, SOFR, Canadian Prime Rate, or CORRA plus margins from 0.50% to 2.50% based on leverage. This is a routine credit facility agreement, not a special situation.
